aloe_vera.name: Aloe Vera
aloe_vera.traditional_use: Commonly used as a soothing plant-based skincare ingredient.
aloe_vera.caution: Some people may experience irritation or allergy. Patch test before use.

oat.name: Oat
benefits: Can help reduce the feeling of dryness
oat.caution: Avoid if you know you are sensitive or allergic to oats.

coconut_oil.name: Coconut Oil
coconut_oil.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a plant-based oil for moisturizing skin.
coconut_oil.caution: May feel heavy and may not suit acne-prone or oily facial skin.

rose_water.name: Rose Water
rose_water.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a refreshing botanical preparation.
benefits: Can be used as part of a simple skincare routine
rose_water.caution: Fragranced products can irritate sensitive skin.

turmeric.name: Turmeric
turmeric.traditional_use: Traditionally used in various cultural skincare preparations.
benefits: Commonly included in traditional skincare preparations
turmeric.caution: Can irritate some skin and may temporarily stain the skin. Avoid aggressive DIY applications.

honey.name: Honey
benefits: Can be included in simple soothing preparations
honey.caution: Avoid if allergic to honey or bee products. Use clean products and avoid applying to broken skin.

sandalwood.name: Sandalwood
sandalwood.traditional_use: Used traditionally in some cultural skincare preparations.
benefits: Used as a traditional botanical ingredient
sandalwood.caution: Fragrance and botanical ingredients can cause irritation or allergy.
